newsitem.title: ITALY: Luxottica in accord with Bulgari.
newsitem.headline: Luxottica in accord with Bulgari.

text.p: Italian optical giant Luxottica Group SpA said Thursday it has signed a letter of intent with Italian luxury jeweller Bulgari SpA to manufacture and distribute a collection of optical frames and sunglasses.

Luxottica said under the five-year agreement it becomes the partner of Bulgari to use its trademark in the global optical market. The first collection of eyewear is due to be launched in the second half of next year.
Bulgari said in a statement the Rome-based jeweller also planned to launch a silk scarf collection in November this year and a line of Bulgari leather goods by the end of 1997.
